bootstrap_binary.note: The checked-in binary predates the canonical FBR-10-OLF2 CI rebuild and is replaced by the workflow before APK compilation.

behavioral_constraints: Body movement is read only from measured retained VNC motor activity
Olfactory input is restricted to retained real MaleCNS ORNs
Tarsal gustatory input is restricted to retained official `leg bristle` gustatory receptors; feeding motor output is read from retained official cb_motor types and never synthesized.

visual_reconstruction.note: The canonical 16,669-node FBC103 is rebuilt from the pinned MaleCNS v1.0 source in CI; the checked-in binary is only a bootstrap asset and must not be interpreted as the V1.19.23 visual reconstruction.

anatomical_visual_map.source: official MaleCNS v1.0 annotations + retained FBC103 indices
anatomical_visual_map.primary_sensory_policy: receptor-organ anchored; central relays not confused with peripheral receptors
anatomical_visual_map.central_policy: conservative cell-type family mapping; unknowns remain CENTRAL_BRAIN
